import pathlib,subprocess,json,base64,re
folder=pathlib.Path('/opt/cps-novel/shared/artifacts/verified/v065/evidence')
b=json.loads((folder/'phase-a-baseline.json').read_text())
q=base64.b64decode('').decode().replace('ARRAY_IDS', 'ARRAY['+','.join("'"+x+"'" for x in b['allIds'])+']')
r=subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-i','-e','PGOPTIONS=-c default_transaction_read_only=on','cps-novel-postgres-1','psql','-X','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-U','postgres','-d','cps_novel','-At'],input=q,text=True,capture_output=True)
assert r.returncode==0, 'readonly_psql_failed_stop'
x=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(r.stdout[r.stdout.index('{'):])[0]
assert x['role']=='postgres' and x['defaultReadOnly']==x['transactionReadOnly']=='on'
assert len(x['mine'])==1 and x['mine'][0]['seriesId']=='131539322'
assert len(x['contract'])==1 and x['contract'][0]['app']=='00de5521-d075-4472-87eb-cc5d1732f4d0' and x['contract'][0]['id'] not in b['allIds']
assert len(x['books'])==53 and sorted(z['id'] for z in x['books'])==b['allIds']
assert all(z['app']==b['appId'] and z['status']=='linked' for z in x['books'])
assert next(z for z in x['books'] if z['id'].startswith('4265a05f'))['language']=='6'
(folder/'phase-a-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PHASE_A_IDENTITY='+json.dumps(x))
print('PHASE_A_IDENTITY=PASS mine=1 series=131539322 books=53 contract_excluded=yes read_only=on')
